The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Kykar and Echoes of Eternity trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.

Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-5793-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-5793-7434--148.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-5793-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.

When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn.

687-1215-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Hope of Ghirapur is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. 687-1215-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Hope of Ghirapur by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Hope of Ghirapur enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Hope of Ghirapur.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Hope of Ghirapur and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Hope of Ghirapur by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-1215-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.
